project_scope.note: The two accepted Helenium amarum varieties are taught inside the species-level learner and are not duplicate species pages. H. quadridentatum remains a provisional installed learner with its range HOLD preserved.

study_strategy.warning: Start with the stem and leaf architecture before the yellow flower head. H. amarum is unwinged; H. elegans, H. autumnale, and H. quadridentatum are winged.
